It’s not “ extra time”— it’s time invested in * you*. Would you say it’s also a moment of mindfulness for you? (e.g., focusing on the sensation of the blade, the rhythm of the process?) Either way, it’s a beautiful way to start the day. 💡✨ Keep up the great habits!
